item.title: Prismatic Princess ☆ Unison Stars
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Unison Shift, Unison Shift: Blossom, Unison Shift: Accent
  • 発売日: 2012-01-27
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: プリズマティックプリンセス☆ユニゾンスターズ
  • 英語名: Prismatic Princess ☆ Unison Stars

别名

  • Unistars

あらすじ

A collaboration game between Unisonshift Blossom and Accent featuring all heroines from all Blossom and Accent games.

One day, the heroines were transported to a strange place. They only found a living animal Uni, the mascot of Unison Shift. Uni explained that they can go back to their original worlds by ‘unison power’, a power that can be formed by singing together in unison. By ChuChu’s advice, they decided to form idol groups to form ‘Unison Power’.
